subject: Unfair extra fee on my hotel payment – refund requested
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing because I am frankly annoyed by an extra charge on my account. On 2026-10-05 I paid 120 EUR at a hotel in Vienna, which came to 47,400 HUF. To my surprise, an additional 711 HUF fee was charged on top of that amount. Nobody warned me about this, and I consider it completely unfair.

My customer number is C-1005. I would like the 711 HUF refunded to my account as soon as possible, along with a clear explanation of why this fee was applied in the first place. If this is some kind of hidden charge, I expect it to be reversed without further argument.

Please confirm once the refund has been processed.

Regards,
Mark Ellison

draft.body:
Dear Mr. Ellison,

Thank you for contacting us about the extra fee on your hotel payment. We have reviewed your complaint and must inform you that we are unable to approve your refund request, as the fee was charged correctly.

The 711 HUF charge is the foreign currency card payment fee. Card payments made in a currency other than HUF are converted at the Danubia card exchange rate and carry a fee of 1.5% of the HUF amount, and this fee is shown as a separate line on your statement [1]. Your hotel payment of 120 EUR was converted to 47,400 HUF, and 1.5% of that amount is 711 HUF, which matches the fee on your statement. Because the bank acted in line with the contract and the fee schedule, no refund or goodwill payment is due [2].

If you are not satisfied with this answer, you may turn to the Pénzügyi Békéltető Testület (Financial Arbitration Board) or to the Magyar Nemzeti Bank (mnb.hu/fogyasztovedelem).

Yours sincerely,
Danubia Bank Complaints Team

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
retrieved.content: Before the loss or theft of the card is reported, the customer may bear losses up to HUF 15,000, unless the transaction was made without strong customer authentication, in which case the customer bears no loss. Online transactions without strong customer authentication (SCA) are refunded in full.

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
retrieved.content: If goods or services paid by card were not delivered or were materially different from what was ordered, the customer should first contact the merchant. If the merchant does not resolve the issue, the bank initiates a chargeback through the card scheme. The chargeback is not a refund decision of the bank: the outcome depends on the merchant's response, typically within 45 days. The answer to the customer must explain that the chargeback was initiated, what documents are needed (order confirmation, correspondence with the merchant), and the expected timeline.

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Card Disputes and Unauthorised Transactions Procedure
retrieved.content: If a customer reports a card or account transaction they did not authorise, the bank refunds the amount immediately and at the latest by the end of the following business day after the report. The only exception is when the bank has reasonable grounds to suspect fraud by the customer and reports this in writing to the supervisory authority. The refund may not be delayed while the bank investigates the customer's possible negligence; liability is assessed afterwards.

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Retail Fee Schedule (Hirdetmény), effective 2026-01-01
retrieved.content: A payment reminder letter costs HUF 2,500. It may be charged only if the installment is unpaid on the date the reminder is generated, and at most once per loan per calendar month. Reminder fees charged in breach of these conditions are refunded.

retrieved.title: Danubia Bank – Complaint Handling Policy (internal), v4.2
retrieved.content: A complaint is upheld when the bank made an error; the customer receives a full refund of the amount wrongly charged plus, for errors causing inconvenience, an optional goodwill credit of up to HUF 5,000 at the handler's discretion. A complaint is partially upheld when only some points are justified; only the justified part is refunded. A complaint is rejected when the bank acted in line with the contract and fee schedule; the answer must explain the applicable rule clearly. Any refund above HUF 200,000 or any decision involving suspected fraud must be escalated to the Complaints Team Lead before approval.

retrieved.content: Card payments in a currency other than HUF are converted at the Danubia card exchange rate and carry a fee of 1.5% of the HUF amount. The fee is shown as a separate line on the statement.

assessment.rationale: The 711 HUF charge is the FX_CARD foreign currency card payment fee, correctly calculated as 1.5% of the 47,400 HUF converted amount (1.5% × 47,400 = 711 HUF), matching transaction T-9031 linked to the hotel purchase T-9030. The fee schedule (fee-schedule#4) expressly provides for this 1.5% fee on non-HUF card payments, shown as a separate statement line, so the bank acted in line with the contract and fee schedule. No bank error occurred, so no refund or goodwill is due; the customer should be given a clear explanation of the applicable rule.
